checks.name: Source endpoints reject public, news-reader and worker-write credentials
Source import creates one managed Strapi source and preserves it on retry
Unauthorized tokens, malformed evidence and protected client review fields cannot publish
Real Strapi atomically saves evidence, records machine review and publishes once
Withdrawn automatic articles are never resurrected by bot retries
The original concept endpoint still cannot approve or publish
A real editor explicitly approves without entering a date, then publishes
An identical untouched bot concept can publish later without creating a duplicate
Changed proposals and human-saved bot concepts cannot be auto-published
Existing dashboard layout is preserved while the approval date becomes server-managed
Reviewer credentials are separate and writer can only submit concepts
The reviewer queue paginates exact saved versions with source configuration
Reviewer publication requires current evidence and cannot replace stored article text
A hold records the control report while preserving the original concept
Reviewer decisions reject changed versions and preserve human-saved drafts
A fresh reviewer fetch cannot disguise an out-of-window source publication date
The reviewer publishes an existing concept using fresh proof, without changing identity or text
Reviewer retries cannot resurrect a manually withdrawn article
